title: Past Continuous vs Past Simple
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has aprendido a combinar dos pasados: uno en progreso (Past Continuous) y otro que lo interrumpe (Past Simple).

stages.title: Concepto Teórico: Interrupciones en el Pasado

parts.visual: A menudo combinamos ambos tiempos: El Past Continuous describe la acción larga en progreso. El Past Simple describe la acción corta que interrumpe. I was typing an email when the phone rang.
parts.audio: We often combine both tenses. The Past Continuous describes the long action in progress. The Past Simple describes the short action that interrupts it. I was typing an email when the phone rang.

parts.visual: Usamos 'when' (cuando) antes de la acción corta (Past Simple) o 'while' (mientras) antes de la acción larga (Past Continuous). While I was presenting, the projector stopped.
parts.audio: We use 'when' before the short action in Past Simple, or 'while' before the long action in Past Continuous. While I was presenting, the projector stopped.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la combinación correcta de tiempos verbales.

questions.question: I ____ an email when the phone rang. (Estaba escribiendo).
questions.explanation: Acción larga en progreso = was typing.

questions.question: I was typing an email when the phone ____. (Sonó - interrupción).
While we ____ the budget, the CEO entered. (Estábamos discutiendo).
While we were discussing the budget, the CEO ____. (Entró).
He ____ to a client when his computer crashed. (Estaba hablando).
He was talking to a client when his computer ____. (Falló).
____ I was waiting for the elevator, I saw the new manager. (Mientras).
I was waiting for the elevator ____ I saw the new manager. (Cuando).
They were working late when the power ____ out. (Se fue).
While she ____ the presentation, someone asked a question. (Estaba dando).
I ____ a coffee when the alarm started. (Estaba tomando).
She ____ when the client arrived. (No estaba trabajando).
What ____ when the manager arrived? (¿Qué estabas haciendo?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta de acción en progreso = were you doing.

questions.question: I ____ the report when you called. (Estaba leyendo).
I was reading the report when you ____. (Llamaste).
While they ____, the network went down. (Estaban actualizando).
We ____ lunch when we heard the news. (Estábamos comiendo).
The printer stopped while I ____ a document. (Estaba imprimiendo).
They ____ the office when it started to rain. (Estaban saliendo de).
I was preparing the meeting room when he ____. (Llegó).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo en Past Continuous (was/were + -ing) o Past Simple (terminación -ed/irregular).

questions.question: I ____ ____ an email when the phone rang. (type - Past Cont.)
I was typing an email when the phone ____. (ring - Past Simple).
While we ____ ____ the budget, he entered. (discuss - Past Cont.)
While we were discussing, he ____. (enter - Past Simple).
He ____ ____ on the phone when it crashed. (talk - Past Cont.)
He was talking when his computer ____. (crash - Past Simple).
____ I was waiting, I saw him. (Mientras).
I was waiting ____ I saw him. (Cuando).
What ____ you ____ when he arrived? (do - Past Cont. pregunta).
I was reading when you ____. (call - Past Simple).
